_help: Hand-curated outside events. Add one object per event. Times are local Eastern. Use "allDay": true and a date-only "start" (YYYY-MM-DD) for all-day events. category: area | benefits | community. Post and Auxiliary events belong in data/events-post.json, not here. Always include the organizer's page in "url" so members can confirm details.

events.title: From Slaves to Soldiers: The 1st Rhode Island Regiment, with Robert A. Geake
events.location: North Kingstown Town Hall (2nd Floor), 80 Boston Neck Road, North Kingstown, RI
events.description: HistWick Speaker Series talk on the 1st Rhode Island Regiment — the Continental Army unit of African American and Native American enlisted men known as the Black Regiment — presented by historian and author Robert A. Geake.

events.description: Check the organizer's page for the route and step-off point.

events.title: WaterFire Salute to Veterans (14th annual)
events.location: State House to WaterPlace Park, Providence
events.description: Opening ceremonies at the State House, torch procession, Veterans Resource Fair on Washington Street (3:00-10:00 p.m.), military vehicle display, memorial tributes at sunset and a Memorial Canoe Ceremony. About 150 veterans serve as torchbearers; sign-up and mobility assistance are on the event page.

events.title: Nathanael Greene, Rhode Island, and the Race to the Dan with Andrew Waters
events.location: Aldrich House, 110 Benevolent Street, Providence, RI 02906
events.description: Rhode Island Historical Society talk by author Andrew Waters on how Nathanael Greene's Rhode Island upbringing shaped his Revolutionary War leadership, focusing on his Race to the Dan retreat across the Carolinas. Registration through the event page.

events.title: Breakfast & Toy Drive for the Sgt. Brian St. Germain Foundation and Toys for Tots
events.location: West Warwick Elks, 60 Clyde Street, West Warwick, RI 02893
events.description: Holiday breakfast with Santa and raffles benefiting the Sergeant Brian St. Germain Foundation and the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots program. $10 per person; children under 5 free. Buy tickets or donate through the Foundation's PayPal link. Bring a new, unwrapped toy for the Toys for Tots bin (optional).
events.source: Sgt. Brian St. Germain Foundation (event flyer)

events.title: 2nd Annual Connecticut Colored Regiments Memorial Walk
events.location: Connecticut's Old State House, 800 Main St, Hartford, CT 06103
events.description: Marks the 161st anniversary of the 29th and 30th Connecticut Colored Regiments' return to Hartford in November 1865, after helping take Richmond. Opening ceremonies at 9:00 a.m.; the walk starts at 9:30 a.m. and follows the soldiers' parade route through downtown Hartford, starting and ending at the Old State House: 3.1 miles, with an optional one-mile route, and a live audio tour on your phone (bring headphones). Free. Hosted by the Alex Breanne Corporation with Connecticut's Old State House; register through SimpleTix.
